purpose: Apples-to-apples model/provider discriminator: run the exact same 24 compiled prompts that failed on Standard FLUX through the Google Gemini API directly, not fal.ai.
prompt_policy: Compile from the exact same current recipe/compiler state; do not add Gemini-specific semantic wording so model is the main changed variable.

expected.note: Input text token charges are additional but small relative to image output cost.

decision_gate.diagnostic: Compare directly with output/semantic_anchor_revalidation_24_v1. If Gemini follows the same prompts substantially better, the evidence shifts strongly toward a FLUX/model-route problem rather than a prompt-content problem.
